title: MentorScript Frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of an i-SASE MentorScript artifact. A MentorScript provides domain-specific guidance that applies to one or more phases or artifact types.

schema.description: Schema identifier for the MentorScript artifact type.

oneOf.description: Single target this MentorScript applies to.
List of targets this MentorScript applies to.

applies-to.description: Phase, artifact type, or context that this MentorScript provides guidance for. Can be a single string or an array of strings.
